matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np

# ── Color palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
REGION_COLORS = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": "#C0392B",   # deep red
    "South Asia":         "#E67E22",   # amber
    "Europe":             "#2471A3",   # steel blue
    "North America":      "#1A5276",   # navy
}
URBAN_COLOR  = "#2471A3"
RURAL_COLOR  = "#A9CCE3"
BG           = "#FAFAFA"
GRID_COLOR   = "#DDDDDD"
SPINE_COLOR  = "#999999"

REGIONS = ["Sub-Saharan Africa", "South Asia", "Europe", "North America"]
REGION_SHORT = ["SSA", "S. Asia", "Europe", "N. Amer."]

# ── Data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
income_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [6, 14, 25, 42, 68],
    "South Asia":         [12, 24, 39, 56, 78],
    "Europe":             [72, 82, 89, 94, 97],
    "North America":      [75, 85, 92, 96, 99],
}
quintiles = ["Q1\n(Lowest)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5\n(Highest)"]

age_data = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": [38, 32, 26, 18, 11, 5],
    "South Asia":         [55, 48, 38, 27, 16, 8],
    "Europe":             [98, 96, 93, 88, 79, 58],
    "North America":      [99, 97, 95, 91, 84, 65],
}
age_groups = ["15–24", "25–34", "35–44", "45–54", "55–64", "65+"]

urban_rural = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": (42, 13),
    "South Asia":         (58, 22),
    "Europe":             (92, 78),
    "North America":      (95, 80),
}

overall = {
    "Sub-Saharan Africa": 27,
    "South Asia":         40,
    "Europe":             89,
    "North America":      93,
}

# ── Figure layout ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 14), facecolor=BG)
fig.patch.set_facecolor(BG)

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
    3, 2,
    figure=fig,
    hspace=0.52,
    wspace=0.38,
    top=0.88, bottom=0.07,
    left=0.07, right=0.97
)

ax_income = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_age    = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_ur     = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_overall= fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax_legend = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
ax_legend.axis('off')

def style_ax(ax, title, xlabel, ylabel):
    ax.set_facecolor(BG)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=8, color="#1A1A1A")
    ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=9, color="#444444", labelpad=4)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=9, color="#444444", labelpad=4)
    ax.tick_params(colors="#555555", labelsize=8.5)
    ax.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color(SPINE_COLOR)
        spine.set_linewidth(0.8)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 105)
    ax.set_yticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
    ax.set_yticklabels(["0%", "20%", "40%", "60%", "80%", "100%"])

# ── Panel A: Income gradient ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
x = np.arange(len(quintiles))
style_ax(ax_income,
         "A  Income Quintile Gradient",
         "Household Income Quintile",
         "Internet Penetration (%)")

for region in REGIONS:
    vals = income_data[region]
    ax_income.plot(x, vals, marker='o', linewidth=2.2,
                   markersize=6, color=REGION_COLORS[region],
                   label=region, zorder=3)
    # annotate Q1 and Q5 spread for SSA and Europe to highlight gap
    if region in ("Sub-Saharan Africa", "Europe", "North America", "South Asia"):
        ax_income.annotate(f"{vals[0]}%",
            xy=(x[0], vals[0]),
            xytext=(-18, 2), textcoords='offset points',
            fontsize=7.5, color=REGION_COLORS[region], fontweight='bold')
        ax_income.annotate(f"{vals[-1]}%",
            xy=(x[-1], vals[-1]),
            xytext=(4, 2), textcoords='offset points',
            fontsize=7.5, color=REGION_COLORS[region], fontweight='bold')

# Draw Q1–Q5 span arrow for SSA
ax_income.annotate('',
    xy=(x[-1], income_data["Sub-Saharan Africa"][-1]),
    xytext=(x[0], income_data["Sub-Saharan Africa"][0]),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#888888', lw=1.0))
ax_income.text(0.5, 38, "62 pp\nspan", fontsize=7.5, color='#555555',
               ha='center', style='italic')

ax_income.set_xticks(x)
ax_income.set_xticklabels(quintiles, fontsize=8)

x2 = np.arange(len(age_groups))
style_ax(ax_age,
         "B  Age Group Gradient",
         "Age Group",
         "Internet Penetration (%)")

for region in REGIONS:
    vals = age_data[region]
    ax_age.plot(x2, vals, marker='s', linewidth=2.2,
                markersize=5.5, color=REGION_COLORS[region],
                label=region, zorder=3)
    # annotate 15-24 and 65+ endpoints
    ax_age.annotate(f"{vals[0]}%",
        xy=(x2[0], vals[0]),
        xytext=(-14, 3), textcoords='offset points',
        fontsize=7.5, color=REGION_COLORS[region], fontweight='bold')
    ax_age.annotate(f"{vals[-1]}%",
        xy=(x2[-1], vals[-1]),
        xytext=(4, 3), textcoords='offset points',
        fontsize=7.5, color=REGION_COLORS[region], fontweight='bold')

# shade youth vs elder gap region
ax_age.axvspan(-0.4, 0.4, alpha=0.06, color='green', zorder=0)
ax_age.axvspan(x2[-1]-0.4, x2[-1]+0.4, alpha=0.06, color='purple', zorder=0)
ax_age.text(0, 102, "Youth\n(15–24)", fontsize=7, color='#336633',
            ha='center', va='top')
ax_age.text(x2[-1], 102, "Elders\n(65+)", fontsize=7, color='#663366',
            ha='center', va='top')

ax_age.set_xticks(x2)
ax_age.set_xticklabels(age_groups, fontsize=8)

# ── Panel C: Urban vs Rural grouped bars ──────────────────────────────────────
n = len(REGIONS)
x3 = np.arange(n)
bar_w = 0.35
style_ax(ax_ur,
         "C  Urban–Rural Divide by Region",
         "Region",
         "Internet Penetration (%)")

urban_vals = [urban_rural[r][0] for r in REGIONS]
rural_vals = [urban_rural[r][1] for r in REGIONS]

bars_u = ax_ur.bar(x3 - bar_w/2, urban_vals, bar_w,
                   color=URBAN_COLOR, label='Urban', zorder=3, alpha=0.9)
bars_r = ax_ur.bar(x3 + bar_w/2, rural_vals, bar_w,
                   color=RURAL_COLOR, label='Rural', zorder=3, alpha=0.9,
                   edgecolor=URBAN_COLOR, linewidth=0.6)

# gap annotations
for i, r in enumerate(REGIONS):
    gap = urban_rural[r][0] - urban_rural[r][1]
    mid = (urban_vals[i] + rural_vals[i]) / 2
    ax_ur.annotate(f"Δ{gap}pp",
        xy=(x3[i], max(urban_vals[i], rural_vals[i]) + 2),
        xytext=(0, 4), textcoords='offset points',
        ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#333333', fontweight='bold')

# value labels on bars
for bar in bars_u:
    ax_ur.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2,
               bar.get_height() + 1.5,
               f"{int(bar.get_height())}%",
               ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, color=URBAN_COLOR, fontweight='bold')
for bar in bars_r:
    ax_ur.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2,
               bar.get_height() + 1.5,
               f"{int(bar.get_height())}%",
               ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5, color='#2471A3', fontweight='bold')

ax_ur.set_xticks(x3)
ax_ur.set_xticklabels(REGION_SHORT, fontsize=8.5)
ax_ur.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8.5, framealpha=0.85)

# ── Panel D: Overall horizontal bars ──────────────────────────────────────────
ax_overall.set_facecolor(BG)
ax_overall.set_title("D  Overall Internet Penetration by Region\n(2023 Estimates)",
                     fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=8, color="#1A1A1A")

y_pos = np.arange(len(REGIONS))
vals_o = [overall[r] for r in REGIONS]
colors_o = [REGION_COLORS[r] for r in REGIONS]

bars_o = ax_overall.barh(y_pos, vals_o, color=colors_o, height=0.55,
                         zorder=3, alpha=0.92)
ax_overall.set_xlim(0, 110)
ax_overall.xaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)
ax_overall.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_overall.set_xticks([0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100])
ax_overall.set_xticklabels(["0%","20%","40%","60%","80%","100%"], fontsize=8.5)
ax_overall.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_overall.set_yticklabels(REGIONS, fontsize=9)
ax_overall.set_xlabel("Internet Penetration (%)", fontsize=9, color="#444444")
ax_overall.tick_params(colors="#555555")
for spine in ax_overall.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(SPINE_COLOR)
    spine.set_linewidth(0.8)
ax_overall.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_overall.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

for bar, val in zip(bars_o, vals_o):
    ax_overall.text(val + 1.5, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2,
                    f"{val}%", va='center', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold',
                    color=colors_o[vals_o.index(val)])

# ── Shared legend ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(color=REGION_COLORS[r], label=r) for r in REGIONS
]
ax_legend.legend(
    handles=legend_handles,
    loc='center',
    ncol=4,
    fontsize=10,
    framealpha=0.9,
    edgecolor=SPINE_COLOR,
    title="Region  (Panels A & B)",
    title_fontsize=9.5,
    handlelength=2,
)

# ── Main title & subtitle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.5, 0.965,
         "The Digital Divide: Internet Penetration Inequality Across Four Dimensions",
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', color='#111111')
fig.text(0.5, 0.945,
         "Income Quintile · Age Group · Urban–Rural · Region  |  2023 Estimates  |  "
         "Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center",
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=9, color='#666666', style='italic')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=BG)
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
